questions.chat: What's the name of the business sending the goods?
questions.voice: What's your business name?

questions.chat: Where are the goods being collected from — London, Manchester, Birmingham or Leeds?
questions.voice: Collecting from London, Manchester, Birmingham or Leeds?

questions.chat: Which city is it going to? We deliver to Berlin, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Paris, Lyon, Amsterdam and Rotterdam.
questions.voice: Which city is it going to?

questions.chat: Is it being delivered to a warehouse (like a fulfilment or distribution centre) or a business address (like a shop or office)?
questions.voice: Is it a warehouse, or a business address like a shop or office?

questions.chat: When will the goods be packed and ready for collection?
questions.voice: What date will the goods be ready for collection?

questions.chat: What matters most: cheapest, fastest, most reliable, or a balance of all three?
questions.voice: What matters most — cheapest, fastest, most reliable, or a balance?

questions.chat: Does it need to arrive by a particular date?
questions.voice: Does it need to arrive by a certain date?

questions.chat: What's the product? A short plain description.
questions.voice: What's the product?

questions.chat: Quick safety check: does the {product} contain a lithium battery, or is it an aerosol or a flammable liquid?
questions.voice: Does it contain a lithium battery, or is it an aerosol or flammable liquid?

questions.chat: Do you have a product code (SKU)? If not, I'll call it ITEM-{n}.
questions.voice: Do you have a product code for it?

questions.chat: How many units of {product} in total?
questions.voice: How many units in total?

questions.chat: How many units are packed in each carton?
questions.voice: How many in each carton?

questions.chat: That's {qty} ÷ {upc} = {cartons} cartons of {product} — correct?
questions.voice: So {cartons} cartons — right?

questions.chat: What's the price of one {product}, in pounds?
questions.voice: What's the price of one unit, in pounds?

questions.chat: How much does one {product} weigh, in kg? (grams is fine too)
questions.voice: How much does one unit weigh?

questions.chat: Do you know the HS code (customs code) for {product}? At least 6 digits.
questions.voice: Do you know the customs HS code? It's at least six digits.

questions.chat: Where was {product} made? (Not where it ships from.)
questions.voice: Which country was it made in?

questions.chat: Is there any other product in this shipment?
questions.voice: Any other products?

questions.chat: So the shipment has {sumCartons} cartons in total — correct?
questions.voice: {sumCartons} cartons in total — right?

questions.chat: The goods add up to {sumValue}. Is that the value on your invoice?
questions.voice: That's {sumValue} in total — is that what's on your invoice?

questions.chat: How many pallets will it be on?
questions.voice: How many pallets?

questions.chat: What's the total gross weight in kg — goods plus cartons and pallets? The goods alone are about {net} kg.
questions.voice: What's the total weight, including cartons and pallets, in kilos?

questions.chat: Have you booked a delivery appointment (time slot) at the warehouse?
questions.voice: Have you booked a delivery slot?

questions.chat: What date is the slot?
questions.voice: What date is the slot?

questions.chat: Is there a maximum you'd like to spend on freight?
Are the goods especially valuable or fragile?
Here's your booking. Would you like to fix anything, or confirm?
questions.voice: Shall I read the summary, or do you want to confirm?
